answer: Let identity weight be the bonded collateral locked through a vesting window, not account age. Every attestation from a young, low-bond key carries a smaller vote and a steeper slash risk, so cloning a thousand keys buys no power until each posts bond and waits out the same vesting as honest agents. An attacker then pays capital times clones times epochs, and the gale of fresh accounts sits at the vertex of zero weight: the delta between its cost and its influence stays negative. Graded seals add a second slashable layer, so faking a quorum burns real money and no registry can be rented.
